channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnamese firms wary of accepting orders bound for Middle East
item.description: Escalating tensions in the Middle East, particularly around the Strait of Hormuz, are prompting Vietnamese logistics providers and exporters to watch developments closely, with many reconsidering whether to accept new shipments to the region.

item.title: Mitsubishi Xpander MT 2026 debuts in Vietnam, priced at $21,700
item.description: Mitsubishi on Thursday officially debuted the Xpander MT 2026 in Vietnam, with the completely built-up model imported from Indonesia carrying a price tag of VND568 million (US$21,700).

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City to tighten technical oversight of dental clinics
item.description: Dental services in Ho Chi Minh City are booming, with thousands of clinics operating and many advanced techniques being introduced. However, this rapid growth also presents challenges in maintaining quality and patient safety, prompting the city’s health sector to strengthen its oversight.

item.title: Hanoi ‘bun rieu’ stall shut over hygiene complaint from Chinese tourist
item.description: Authorities in Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi have ordered the closure of a long-standing ‘bun rieu’ (Vietnamese crab noodle soup) eatery on Hang Luoc Street following hygiene concerns raised by a Chinese tourist on social media.

item.title: Indonesia gives Meta 'stern warning' over disinformation
item.description: JAKARTA -- Indonesia's communications ministry has issued a "stern warning" to Meta Platforms Inc for failing to curb the spread of online gambling and disinformation, the ministry said on Thursday.

item.title: ADB sees modest growth impact on Asia if Middle East conflict lasts about a month
item.description: MANILA -- The Asian Development Bank's chief economist said on Friday that if the Middle East conflict and closure of the Strait of Hormuz last only about a month, as some U.S. projections suggest, the impact on growth in developing Asia would be modest, with only a slight and temporary "downward blip" in annual GDP.

item.title: Vietnam prepares evacuation plans for citizens in Middle East amid rising tensions
item.description: Vietnam has prepared evacuation plans for its citizens in the Middle East as regional tensions escalate, though no Vietnamese nationals have been reported being affected by the conflict involving the U.S., Israel and Iran, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: OpenAI hit with lawsuit claiming ChatGPT acted as an unlicensed lawyer
item.description: WASHINGTON - ChatGPT maker OpenAI has been accused in a new lawsuit of practicing law without a U.S. license and helping a former disability claimant breach a settlement and flood a federal court docket with meritless filings.

item.title: Japan and ASEAN cooperate on cybersecurity measures
item.description: “We believed we had taken the necessary and sufficient measures. However, this attack was advanced and sophisticated beyond what we had anticipated.” Atsushi Katsuki, president and CEO of Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd., a major Japanese beverage and food company, said this at a news conference on November 27, 2025, regarding a system disruption caused by ransomware (a ransom-demanding computer virus).

item.title: Vietnam fines driver $1,333 for wrong-way driving on expressway
item.description: Vietnamese traffic police have fined a person who drove in the wrong direction on the Hanoi–Bac Giang Expressway, forcing several motorists to brake suddenly to avoid a collision, authorities said on Thursday.
